When to Fill the Option Form?

The SSC JE Option Form is as followed:

  1. Post Tier-II Examination Results: Candidates who qualify for the Tier-II (Descriptive Paper) exam are invited to fill the form.
  2. Before Document Verification (DV): It must be completed and submitted online or offline as instructed by the SSC.

How to Fill SSC Junior Engineer 2024 Online Form

Steps to Fill the SSC JE 2024 Online Form

1. Visit the Official Website

  • Go to the official SSC website: https://ssc.nic.in.

2. Registration (One-Time)

  • If you’re a new user, click on the “Register Now” link in the Login section.
  • Fill in the basic details:
    • Name, Father’s Name, and Mother’s Name (as per your matriculation certificate).
    • Date of Birth.
    • Email ID and Mobile Number.
  • Complete the verification using the OTP sent to your email and phone.
  • Upload required documents:
    • Recent passport-sized photograph (20 KB – 50 KB, in JPEG format).
    • Signature (10 KB – 20 KB, in JPEG format).
    • Category/Disability Certificate (if applicable).
  • Submit and note down your Registration ID and Password.

3. Login

  • Use your Registration ID and Password to log in.

4. Fill Application Form

  • Select the exam: “SSC Junior Engineer 2024”.
  • Provide personal details such as:
    • Address.
    • Category and sub-category (if applicable).
    • Preferences for examination centers.
  • Fill in educational qualifications.
  • Upload additional documents, if required.

5. Fee Payment

  • Pay the application fee:
    • General/OBC: ₹100.
    • SC/ST/PWD/Female: No fee.
  • Payment modes:
    • Online: Credit/Debit Card, UPI, or Net Banking.
    • Offline: SBI Challan (generate challan and pay at the nearest SBI branch).

6. Preview and Submit

  • Review your application carefully.
  • Ensure all details are correct and documents are uploaded properly.
  • Submit the form and save the confirmation page.

7. Print the Application

  • Download and print the final application form for future reference.

Documents Required:

  • Scanned photograph and signature.
  • ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, etc.).
  • Category certificate (if applicable)
